A QUIETER KIND OF STUDIO

Less doing.
More being.

A light-filled room in Bristol. A familiar face on screen. However you join us, there's space to move at your own pace.

No perfect poses, no competition. Just considered teaching and a warm welcome, whether you're starting or returning.

01 / ARRIVE

You don't have to be flexible.
Just a little curious.

Mats and props are part of the in-studio concept. Online students choose a comfortable, clear space. For injuries, pregnancy or health concerns, check suitability with your clinician and teacher.

Before your first class

What should I bring?

Wear clothes you can move in and bring water. Discuss equipment and access needs with the studio before a real visit.

How do online classes work?

Select an online option in the timetable. This demonstration supplies no meeting links, credentials or live class stream.

Can I join as a beginner?

Explore Hatha or Meditation and speak to your teacher about adapting the practice. This site offers no medical advice.
